mapper.sql: select rule_id, rule_name, document_type, transfer_type, scope_type, scope_id, condition_type, condition_operator, condition_value, approval_mode, required_count, reject_action, allow_self_approve, priority, status, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from inv_transfer_approval_rule
